Brand: Vantaflow

Service: AI Search Visibility / GEO audits for B2B SaaS
Audience: B2B SaaS founders, growth teams, marketers, and agencies

Important pages:

Description:
Vantaflow audits how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity describe, compare, and recommend B2B SaaS products, then provides content, positioning, and website fixes to improve AI visibility.
